evidence.title: AI data startup Micro1 reaches $500M gross run rate amid AI training boom

summary: Micro1, a startup specializing in AI training data, has achieved a $500 million gross run rate amid soaring demand for AI model development. The milestone underscores the growing importance of high-quality datasets in the AI industry.
title: AI Data Startup Micro1 Hits $500M Run Rate as AI Training Demand Surges
